A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Leu354Pro variant is the first reported missense mutation in FXIII A subunit.
Leu354 is a new mutation site for factor XIII deficiency, and that this site is located in the core domain of FXIIIa molecule.
Leu354 is the most important residue within the core domain, and its replacement with a proline results in a nonfunctional FXIIIA molecule.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Leu354 lies within the core domain, which is a highly conserved region of the molecule.
Leu354 is a critical residue in the FXIIIA structure, as its substitution results in a severe FXIII deficiency.
